args.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the first texture sheet for our pixel game terrain. KEEP exact full-bleed 4 columns x 3 rows grid and all12 positions. The first image has interiors much TOO BLACK, making ugly rectangular holes beside the edge material in the other reference images. Change ONLY material base colors and subtle pattern contrast, no text or objects. Each cell must have the following approximate middle tone, not near-black. This is intended to seamlessly match the middle of the corresponding square terrain material shown in other reference sprite sheets. TOP LEFT TO BOTTOM RIGHT: 1: #362e34 peat; 2:  #493843 sandstone; 3: #33394a slate; 4: #454758 limestone; 5: #282934 dressed masonry; 6: #292834 mineral rock; 7: #404e4e porous limestone; 8: #2c4243 submerged masonry; 9: #2d2a32 cleft stone; 10: #282836 glassy basalt; 11: #2c2f3e precision masonry; 12: #303448 plain stone. For all patches keep small restrained crisp pixel grain with very subtle irregular material variation. Base color should dominate, medium dark as specified, do NOT apply any automatic dark vignette, dark gradient, edge bevel, frame or black background. No bright veins, no motifs. Gentle seams only for masonry cells5,8,11. Whole sheet opaque 4x3 cells, no gutters. Preserve natural coarse matter from the original terrain, at fine native pixel density. The goal is CONTINUOUS MATERIAL MASS across tile edges and fill, not black boxes.
